reason: Photos opens my screenshots fine and I never think about it. The 3D formats and fast next/back are interesting, but a 0.4 from one dev is not enough for me to change the default.
why_switch_or_not: I'd install the portable zip once to open a TGA, DDS, EXR and a GLB, because that is my actual work and Photos can't do most of it. But I want a viewer that only views, and this one ships a gallery, an editor, batch convert and a scanner importer I'd never use. Photos opens my screenshots and PNGs well enough, and I don't trust a single-developer 0.4 to still be around next year, so I wouldn't make it the default.
current_app_pros: It's built in, it opens when I double-click, and it needs no setup. PNG screenshots open instantly enough and it never gets in my way.
current_app_pains: It can't open TGA, DDS, EXR or HDR, and it has no 3D models. It is slow to start sometimes and has some cloud and gallery clutter. For those formats I already use other tools.
objection: One developer, version 0.4: will it still be maintained next year? Also it has a lot of extra features when I only want a viewer.
would_change_my_mind: A year or more of steady updates, plus a plain viewer-only mode that hides the gallery and editor, and clearly working TGA/DDS/EXR/GLB previews that I can verify on my own files.
